_doc: gboxlinux: ONE set of Guard Box detection thresholds for the phone Guard Box (Dart: app/lib/cashguard/guard_box_model.dart, app/lib/ipcam/ipcam_logic.dart, app/lib/shop_motion.dart) and the Linux / Raspberry Pi / Windows Guard Box (Python: shopbox.thresholds). tests/test_guardbox_linux.py fails when the two sides drift apart.
